items.heading: Plokkfiskur
details: Key ingredients: cod or haddock, potato, onion, bechamel sauce
Boil fish and potato separately until tender.
Flake the fish and mash the potato coarsely.
Make a simple white sauce with butter, flour and milk.
Combine the fish, potato and sauce, warming through before serving.

items.heading: Icelandic Lamb Soup
details: Key ingredients: lamb, root vegetables, oats, herbs
Simmer lamb pieces in water with fresh herbs until tender.
Add root vegetables like carrot, turnip and potato.
Stir in a little oats or rice to thicken the broth.
Cook until the vegetables are soft and serve hot.
